description: BARONS COURT STATION: From Monday 6 July until November, westbound trains will not call at Barons Court. If travelling westbound from the station, please use eastbound District or Piccadilly line trains and change to westbound services at West Kensington (on the District line) or Earls Court (on the Piccadilly line) and change to westbound services. If travelling westbound to the station, please continue to Hammersmith and change for eastbound District or Piccadilly line trains.

WEMBLEY PARK STATION: From Monday 10 March until Autumn 2026, no lift service between the street (Wembley Way / car park) and ticket hall. Step-free access is still available by using the entrance/exit on Bridge Road which is level between street and ticket hall. Lifts remain available to all platforms.

SNARESBROOK STATION: Until further notice, the westbound platform entrance and exit is closed for repairs to a water leak. Please use the entrance and exits on the eastbound platform via the footbridge

KEW GARDENS STATION: Step-free platform interchange between platforms requires a 600m journey via street. Use the North End entrance for the westbound platform. Use the Station Approach entrance for the eastbound platform. To avoid the street level journey, please take a westbound train to Richmond and change to eastbound services there.

Step-free routes from Liverpool Street to Kings Cross St Pancras and Euston (via Euston Square): For Kings Cross, take a Metropolitan line eastbound train (platform 1) to Aldgate. Stay on the train. After a few minutes, the train reverses and travels westbound: you can get off at Kings Cross step-free. Eastbound journeys from Kings Cross are step-free direct to Liverpool Street. 

For Euston, take a Metropolitan line eastbound train (platform 1) to Aldgate. Stay on the train. After a few minutes, the train reverses and travels westbound and you can get off at Euston Square step-free. It is then a 10 minute step-free walk via the street to Euston. Euston Square is step-free westbound only, so you cannot do the same journey in reverse to return to Liverpool Street. 

Mini ramps are available at Liverpool Street, Kings Cross and Euston Square. To request a mini ramp speak to a member of staff before you start your journey.

WATERLOO STATION: Although step-free access is available to/from the Bakerloo line southbound platform, the curved platform has large gaps between train and platform, has no manual boarding ramps, and is unsuitable for wheelchair users and those with pushchairs.

PIMLICO STATION: From Friday 9 October until late December, no down escalator. Please use the stairs. To avoid the stairs, or if you are travelling with luggage, buggies or small children, please use local bus services 2, 36, or 185 from Vauxhall Bridge Road, stop A for Victoria and stop D for Vauxhall. Route 360 also serves Vauxhall from stop H on Bessborough Street.

CANADA WATER STATION: Until Spring 2027, no step-free access between street and ticket hall level at this station. This is while we carry out lift replacement work. For step-free access to the Jubilee line, take bus 47 or 188 from stop B1 in the bus station to Bermondsey. For step-free access to the Windrush line, take any bus from stop B2, or bus 1 or 381 from stop C in the bus station to Surrey Quays. Alternatively, it is about an 800m journey to Surrey Quays at street level via Deal Porters Way. You will not be able to use the lift between the street and ticket hall to enter the station. Please plan ahead and allow more time for your journey

OVAL STATION: Until mid December, Oval station will operate with an 'up' escalator service only, while planned maintenance takes place on one escalator. Please take care when using the spiral staircase, which has 80 steps. Alternatively, use local buses to nearby stations. Stockwell: Bus 155, from stop R on Kennington Park Road, Vauxhall: Bus 36 185 or 436, from stop D on Harleyford Street

ELEPHANT & CASTLE UNDERGROUND STATION: Until late October, the lifts at the Northern line entrance are out of service for repairs. Please exit and enter the station via the Bakerloo line entrance in London Road.

EARL'S COURT STATION: Until the end of service on Thursday 5 November, there will be no step-free access to/from the westbound District line. If you are starting a westbound step-free journey at Earl's Court, take an eastbound District line train to Victoria and change there for a westbound train. To complete a westbound step-free journey at Earl's Court, take an Ealing Broadway or Richmond train to Hammersmith and change there for an eastbound train back to Earl's Court.

BANK AND MONUMENT STATIONS: From Monday 20 October 2025 until early 2027. Replacement of escalators 4 and 5. These connect the Northern line platforms with the District and Circle line platforms. While this work takes place, the walking route between these platforms will be closed. Please allow a little longer for your journey and follow the signs, which will direct you via an alternative walking route. Depending on your journey, this route may be via street level. To pay the correct fare, just touch out as you exit and touch back in again, as you re-enter.
